inputSchema.title: CreateItemRequest

board_id.title: Board Id
board_id.description: The board's unique identifier. Note: Subitems boards are not supported for this action; use create_subitem mutation instead.

group_id.title: Group Id
group_id.description: Optional group ID where the item will be created.

item_name.title: Item Name
item_name.description: Name of the new item. Maximum length is 256 characters.

column_values.title: Column Values
column_values.description: Column values for the new item. Accepts either a JSON string or an object/dict. Keys must be valid column IDs and values must match the column type. For date columns, use nested structure: {"date": {"date": "YYYY-MM-DD"}}. For people columns, use array of person IDs: {"person": {"personsAndTeams": [{"id": 123, "kind": "person"}]}}. For status columns, use index or label: {"status": {"index": 0}} or {"status": {"label": "Done"}}. Example: {"date": {"date": "2023-12-01"}} or {"status": {"index": 0}}.

inputSchema.description: Request model for creating a new item in Monday.com.
